```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

green <- "#1E4D2B"; gold <- "#FFB81C"; grey <- "#9AA5A0"

totals   <- read_csv("data/totals.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
tot      <- setNames(totals$value, totals$metric)
sources  <- read_csv("data/traffic_source_medium.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
channels <- read_csv("data/channels.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
pages    <- read_csv("data/pages.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
devices  <- read_csv("data/devices.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
tracking <- read_csv("data/tracking_validation.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
clean_layout <- function(p, ...) {
  p |> layout(font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif"),
              margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 10), ...) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

# Acquisition

## Row {height=22%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Sessions"
list(icon = "people", color = "#F1F5F2", value = fmt(tot[["sessions"]]))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Active Users"
list(icon = "person-check", color = "#F1F5F2", value = fmt(tot[["active_users"]]))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Engagement Rate"
list(icon = "lightning-charge", color = "#F1F5F2", value = paste0(tot[["engagement_rate"]], "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Page Views"
list(icon = "eye", color = "#F1F5F2", value = fmt(tot[["views"]]))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Key Events Recorded"
list(icon = "flag", color = "#FFF4D6", value = tot[["key_events"]])
```

## Row {height=47%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Sessions by Source / Medium (top 10)"
sources |>
  mutate(source_medium = reorder(source_medium, sessions),
         col = ifelse(sessions == max(sessions), green, grey)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~sessions, y = ~source_medium, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = ~col),
          text = ~fmt(sessions), textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x} sessions<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 560)), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Sessions by Channel"
channels |>
  mutate(channel = reorder(channel, sessions)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~sessions, y = ~channel, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = green),
          text = ~paste0(round(sessions / sum(sessions) * 100), "%"),
          textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x} sessions<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 580)), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

## Row {height=35%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Engagement Rate vs. Time on Site (sources with 5+ sessions)"
sources |>
  filter(sessions >= 5) |>
  mutate(bubble = 10 + sqrt(sessions) * 2) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~avg_engagement_sec, y = ~engagement_rate,
          type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text", text = ~source_medium,
          textposition = ~ifelse(source_medium == "ig / social", "middle right", "top center"),
          textfont = list(size = 11, color = "#1F2933"),
          marker = list(size = ~bubble, color = green, opacity = .7),
          customdata = ~sessions,
          hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Engagement rate: %{y}%<br>Avg time: %{x}s<br>Sessions: %{customdata}<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "Avg engagement time per session (sec)", range = c(15, 70)),
               yaxis = list(title = "Engagement rate (%)", range = c(30, 108)), showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Column {width=40%}

::: {.card title="What the acquisition data says"}
- **Instagram drives over half of all traffic** (472 of 902 sessions, 52%) with a strong 76% engagement rate, but visits are short (26s).
- **Google organic visitors stay twice as long** (56s vs. 26s), so search brings people who are actively looking for services.
- **Direct traffic has the lowest engagement** (57%), likely people checking the homepage quickly.
- **Key events = 0** in reports so far. `generate_lead` was only just confirmed in DebugView, so lead counts should start appearing in the next reporting window.
:::

# Content & Devices

## Row {height=55%}

### Column {width=55%}

```{r}
#| title: "Top 10 Pages by Views"
pages |>
  mutate(page = reorder(page, views),
         col = ifelse(page == "Contact", gold, green)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~views, y = ~page, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = ~col), text = ~views, textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x} views<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 980)), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

### Column {width=45%}

```{r}
#| title: "Avg Engagement Time per Page (sec)"
pages |>
  mutate(page = reorder(page, avg_engagement_sec)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~avg_engagement_sec, y = ~page, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = grey), text = ~paste0(avg_engagement_sec, "s"),
          textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x}s avg engagement<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 62)), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

## Row {height=45%}

### Column {width=55%}

```{r}
#| title: "Active Users by Device"
devices |>
  mutate(device = factor(device, levels = rev(device))) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~active_users, y = ~device, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = c(green, grey, grey)),
          text = ~paste0(fmt(active_users), " (", round(active_users / sum(active_users) * 100, 1), "%)"),
          textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x} users<extra></extra>") |>
  clean_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 860)), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

### Column {width=45%}

::: {.card title="What the content data says"}
- **The homepage gets 50% of all views** but holds attention for only **12s**, so it's the biggest opportunity for the impact-stats redesign the client asked for.
- **Volunteer (52s) and Therapy (50s) pages hold attention the longest**, which shows strong intent on the pages tied to the client's goals.
- **Contact** (gold) gets 84 views but only 18s of engagement. That's fine for a form page, but it's worth tracking how many of those turn into `generate_lead`.
- **88% of users are on mobile**, so every redesign and ad landing page should be built mobile-first.
:::

# Tracking Health

## Row {height=66%}

```{r}
#| title: "GA4 Event Validation (DebugView & Admin)"
datatable(tracking,
          colnames = c("Event / Setting", "Where verified", "Parameters checked", "Status"),
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 10, ordering = FALSE)) |>
  formatStyle("status",
              color = styleEqual(
                c("Firing", "Firing (marked as key event)",
                  "Configured; no stream data yet", "Not linked yet"),
                c(green, green, "#B7791F", "#B42318")),
              fontWeight = "bold")
```

## Row {height=34%}

### Column {width=50%}

::: {.card title="Data notes"}
- **Property:** Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy (GA4)
- **Date range:** Sep 18 – Oct 15, 2026 (last 28 days). Data starts around **Oct 7**, when tracking went live.
- **Source:** GA4 standard reports (Traffic acquisition, Pages and screens, Tech details), Realtime, DebugView, and Admin → Events.
- Tables show the top 10 rows of each report.
:::

::: {.card title="Next steps for the CEP"}
1. **Confirm `generate_lead` shows up in reports** in the next 24–48 hours.
2. **Wire up `qualify_lead` and `close_convert_lead`** so the full lead funnel is tracked.
3. **Link GA4 to BigQuery** for raw event export and SQL analysis.
4. **Add UTM tags to Instagram and Linktree links** so social campaigns are tracked by name, and look into the 32 "(not set)" campaign sessions.
5. **Use this baseline** to measure Google Ad Grants performance once the campaign launches (AO4).
